title.en: Volume 445 Biographies 232: Wu Kedu, Zhu Yixin, Tu Keshou, An Weijun, Wen Ti, Jiang Chunlin
title.raw: 卷445 列傳二百三十二 吴可读 朱一新 屠可守 安维峻 文悌 江春霖

sentences.zh: 列傳二百三十二

translations.literal: Biographies, number two hundred thirty-two.
translations.idiomatic: Biography 232.

sentences.zh: 吳可讀潘敦儼朱一新屠仁守吳兆泰何金壽安維峻

translations.literal: Wu Kedu, Pan Dunyi, Zhu Yixin, Tu Renshou, Wu Zhaotai, He Jinshou, An Weijun.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Kedu, Pan Dunyi, Zhu Yixin, Tu Renshou, Wu Zhaotai, He Jinshou, and An Weijun.

sentences.zh: 文悌江春霖

translations.literal: Wen Ti, Jiang Chunlin.
translations.idiomatic: Wen Ti and Jiang Chunlin.

sentences.zh: 吳可讀，字柳堂，甘肅皋蘭人。

translations.literal: Wu Kedu, courtesy name Liutang, was a native of Gaolan in Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Kedu, styled Liutang, came from Gaolan in Gansu.

sentences.zh: 初以舉人官伏羌訓導。

translations.literal: At first, as a provincial graduate, he served as educational instructor of Fuqiang.
translations.idiomatic: He first entered office as educational instructor of Fuqiang on the strength of his provincial examination rank.

sentences.zh: 道光三十年，成進士，授刑部主事。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year of Daoguang he passed the metropolitan examination and was appointed a principal clerk in the Ministry of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: In 1850 he became a jinshi and received appointment as a principal clerk in the Ministry of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 晉員外郎，遭憂去，主講蘭山書院。

translations.literal: He was promoted to vice director, but left office upon bereavement and served as lecturer at Lanshan Academy.
translations.idiomatic: Promoted to vice director, he resigned when mourning his parents and took the head lectureship at Lanshan Academy.

sentences.zh: 會撒拉番蠢動，被命佐團練。

translations.literal: When the Salar tribesmen stirred up trouble in rebellion, he was ordered to assist in organizing local militia.
translations.idiomatic: When the Salar rose in unrest, he was assigned to help organize local defense forces.

sentences.zh: 服闋，起故官。

translations.literal: When mourning ended, he was restored to his former post.
translations.idiomatic: After his mourning period he returned to his former office.

sentences.zh: 遷吏部郎中，轉御史。

translations.literal: He was transferred to director in the Ministry of Personnel, then made censor.
translations.idiomatic: He moved to director in the Ministry of Personnel and then became a censor.

sentences.zh: 各國使臣請覲，議禮久未決，可讀請免拜跪，時論韙之。

translations.literal: When foreign envoys requested audience, deliberation on ceremonial procedures long went unresolved; Kedu memorialized that kneeling and prostration should be waived, and contemporary opinion approved.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys from various countries sought audience, and court debate over protocol dragged on until Kedu argued that bowing and kneeling should be dispensed with—a view widely applauded at the time.

sentences.zh: 烏魯木齊提督成祿誣民為逆，擊殺多人，虛飾胜狀，為左宗棠所劾。

translations.literal: Cheng Lu, military governor of Urumqi, falsely charged commoners with rebellion, killed many in assault, and fraudulently embellished reports of victory; he was impeached by Zuo Zongtang.
translations.idiomatic: Zuo Zongtang impeached Cheng Lu, military governor of Urumqi, who had falsely labeled civilians rebels, slaughtered many, and padded his victory reports.

sentences.zh: 可讀繼陳其罪有可斬者十，不可緩者五，尋逮問，讞上論斬，廷臣請改監候。

translations.literal: Kedu followed with a memorial detailing ten capital offenses and five that brooked no delay; soon Cheng was arrested and interrogated, the verdict recommended execution, but court officials requested commutation to imprisonment awaiting execution.
translations.idiomatic: Kedu then submitted ten capital charges and five urging immediate punishment; Cheng was soon arrested and tried, the sentence returned as death, but ministers asked that it be reduced to imprisonment pending execution.

sentences.zh: 可讀憤甚，复疏爭：「請斬成祿以謝甘民，再斬臣以謝成祿。

translations.literal: Kedu was greatly enraged and memorialized again in protest: "I beg that Cheng Lu be executed to appease the people of Gansu, and that I be executed next to appease Cheng Lu."
translations.idiomatic: Furious, Kedu protested again: "Execute Cheng Lu to satisfy the people of Gansu, then execute me to satisfy Cheng Lu."

sentences.zh: 」語過戇直，被訶責，鐫三級。

translations.literal: " His words were excessively blunt and obstinate; he was rebuked and demoted three ranks.
translations.idiomatic: His language was judged rashly forthright; he was scolded and stripped of three ranks.

sentences.zh: 歸，复掌教蘭山。

translations.literal: He returned home and again headed teaching at Lanshan.
translations.idiomatic: He went home and resumed the Lanshan lectureship.

sentences.zh: 逾年，穆宗崩，德宗纘業，起吏部主事。

translations.literal: The next year, Emperor Muzong died and Emperor Dezong succeeded; he was recalled as principal clerk in the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: A year later, after Emperor Tongzhi's death and Emperor Guangxu's accession, he was recalled as principal clerk in the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 光緒五年，穆宗奉安惠陵，自請隨赴襄禮。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Guangxu, when Emperor Muzong was installed at Huiling, he volunteered to accompany the funeral rites.
translations.idiomatic: In 1879, when Emperor Tongzhi was laid to rest at Huiling, he asked leave to join the funeral procession.

sentences.zh: 還次薊州，宿廢寺，自縊，未絕，仰藥死，於懷中得遺疏，則請為穆宗立嗣也。

translations.literal: On the return leg he stopped at Jizhou, lodged in an abandoned temple, attempted hanging, and before life ceased took poison; a final memorial found in his robe pleaded that an heir be established for Muzong.
translations.idiomatic: On the way back he halted at Jizhou, stayed in a ruined temple, tried hanging, then swallowed poison when that failed; the testament in his robe urged naming an heir for Tongzhi.

sentences.zh: 其言曰：「罪臣聞治不諱亂，安不忘危。

translations.literal: Its words read: "This guilty official has heard that in governing one does not avoid speaking of disorder, and in security one does not forget peril."
translations.idiomatic: It said: "Your guilty servant has heard that good government does not shrink from disorder, nor security from danger."

sentences.zh: 危亂而可諱忘，則進苦口於堯舜，為無疾呻吟，陳隱患於聖明，為不祥舉動。

translations.literal: If peril and disorder can be concealed and forgotten, then offering bitter counsel to Yao and Shun would be groaning without illness, and stating hidden dangers to a sage sovereign would be an inauspicious act.
translations.idiomatic: If one may gloss over danger, then frank counsel to sage rulers would pass for idle complaint, and warning of hidden troubles before an enlightened throne would count as ill-omened conduct.

sentences.zh: 罪臣前因言事獲譴，蒙我先皇帝曲賜矜全，免臣以斬而死，以囚而死，以傳訊觸忌而死。

translations.literal: This guilty official was earlier punished for memorializing; my late emperor mercifully spared me, exempting me from death by beheading, death in prison, and death from interrogation that touched taboos.
translations.idiomatic: Your guilty servant was once punished for speaking out; my late emperor mercifully spared me from death by the blade, death in prison, and death from interrogation that touched forbidden matters.

sentences.zh: 犯三死而未死，不求生而再生，則今日罪臣未盡之餘年，皆我先皇帝數年前所賜也。

translations.literal: Having incurred three deaths yet not died, and not seeking life yet living again, the remaining years of this guilty official today were all granted by my late emperor years ago.
translations.idiomatic: I incurred three deaths yet did not die; I did not seek life yet live again—so every year that remains to your guilty servant today was granted by my late emperor years ago.

sentences.zh: 欽奉兩宮皇太后懿旨，以醇親王之子承繼文宗顯皇帝為子，入承大統為嗣皇帝，俟嗣皇帝生有皇子，即承繼大行皇帝為嗣。

translations.literal: Respectfully receiving the august edicts of the two empress dowagers, the son of Prince Chun was adopted as son to Emperor Wenzong Xian and entered to inherit the great succession as heir emperor; when the heir emperor should bear a son, that son would succeed the late emperor as heir.
translations.idiomatic: By the august edicts of the two empress dowagers, Prince Chun's son was adopted as son to Emperor Xianfeng and entered to inherit the throne as heir emperor; when the heir emperor should bear a son, that son would succeed the late emperor as heir.

sentences.zh: 我皇上仁孝性成，承我兩宮皇太后授以寶位，將來千秋萬歲時，必能以我兩宮皇太后今日之心為心。

translations.literal: Our emperor, filial and benevolent by nature, received the imperial seal from the two empress dowagers; in myriad years to come he will surely take the heart of the two empress dowagers today as his own heart.
translations.idiomatic: Our emperor, filial and benevolent by nature, received the throne from the two empress dowagers; in ages to come he will surely hold the same heart they hold today.

sentences.zh: 而在廷之忠佞不齊，即眾論之異同不一。

translations.literal: Yet loyalty and flattery in court are not uniform, and public opinion is not of one voice.
translations.idiomatic: Yet loyalty and flattery at court are not uniform, and public opinion is divided.

sentences.zh: 以宋初宰相趙普之賢，而猶首背杜太后；

translations.literal: Even Zhao Pu, worthy prime minister at the beginning of Song, first turned against Empress Dowager Du;
translations.idiomatic: Even Zhao Pu, that worthy Song founder's minister, first betrayed Empress Dowager Du;

sentences.zh: 以明大學士王直之為舊臣，而猶以黃𤥠請立景帝太子一疏不出我輩為愧。

translations.literal: Even Wang Zhi of Ming, as an old minister, still felt ashamed that he had not produced a memorial like Huang Fu's urging establishment of the Jingdi emperor's son as heir.
translations.idiomatic: Even Wang Zhi, an old Ming minister, still felt ashamed that he had not produced a memorial like Huang Fu's urging that the Jingtai emperor's son be made heir.

sentences.zh: 賢者如此，遑問不肖？

translations.literal: If the worthy are thus, how much more the unworthy?
translations.idiomatic: If the worthy act thus, what of the unworthy?

sentences.zh: 舊人如此，奚責新進？

translations.literal: If old ministers are thus, how can new appointees be blamed?
translations.idiomatic: If old ministers act thus, how can new appointees be blamed?

sentences.zh: 名位已定者如此，況在未定。

translations.literal: If those whose titles and positions are fixed are thus, how much more those not yet fixed.
translations.idiomatic: If those whose titles are already settled act thus, how much more when succession is still unsettled.

sentences.zh: 惟有仰求我兩宮皇太后再降諭旨，將來大統，仍歸大行皇帝嗣子，嗣皇帝雖百斯男，中外臣工均不得以異言進。

translations.literal: Only humbly to beg the two empress dowagers to issue another edict: the future succession should still return to a son of the late emperor; though the heir emperor should have a hundred sons, ministers within and without may not advance dissenting views.
translations.idiomatic: I humbly beg the two empress dowagers to issue another edict: let the future succession revert to a son of the late emperor; though the heir emperor should father a hundred sons, no minister at home or abroad may press a contrary view.

sentences.zh: 如此，則猶是本朝子以傳子之家法，而我大行皇帝未有子而有子，即我兩宮皇太后未有孫而有孫，異日繩繩揖揖相引於萬代者，皆我兩宮皇太后所自出而不可移易者也。

translations.literal: Thus it would still be this dynasty's house law of son passing to son; our late emperor would without a son yet have a son; the two empress dowagers without a grandson yet have a grandson; and in future ages the endless succession would all stem from what the two empress dowagers themselves ordained and cannot be altered.
translations.idiomatic: Thus the dynasty's house law of son succeeding son would stand; our late emperor would without a son yet have one; the two empress dowagers without a grandson yet have one; and the endless line stretching through ten thousand generations would all flow from what the two empress dowagers themselves ordained and cannot be altered.

sentences.zh: 彼時罪臣即欲有言，繼思降調不得越職言事。

translations.literal: At that time this guilty official wished to speak, but then reflected that after demotion one may not exceed one's office in memorializing.
translations.idiomatic: At that time your guilty servant wished to speak, but then reflected that after demotion one may not exceed one's office in memorializing.

sentences.zh: 今逢我大行皇帝奉安山陵，恐積久漸忘，則罪臣昔日所留以有待者，今則迫不及待矣。

translations.literal: Now, meeting the installation of our late emperor at the mountain tomb, fearing that with long delay it may be gradually forgotten, what this guilty official once left to await its time can no longer wait.
translations.idiomatic: Now, as our late emperor is laid to rest at the mountain tomb, I fear that with time this will be forgotten; what your guilty servant once held back for a fitting moment can wait no longer.

sentences.zh: 謹以我先皇帝所賜餘年，為我先皇帝上乞數行懿旨，惟望我兩宮皇太后、我皇上憐其哀鳴，勿以為無疾呻吟、不祥舉動，則罪臣雖死無憾。

translations.literal: Respectfully using the remaining years my late emperor granted, I beg on behalf of my late emperor for a few lines of august decree; only hoping the two empress dowagers and our emperor will pity this cry of anguish and not regard it as groaning without illness or inauspicious conduct, then this guilty official dies without regret.
translations.idiomatic: With the remaining years my late emperor granted, I beg on his behalf for a few lines of august decree; I only pray the two empress dowagers and our emperor will pity this cry of anguish and not dismiss it as idle complaint or ill-omened conduct—then your guilty servant may die without regret.

sentences.zh: 尤原我兩宮皇太后、我皇上體聖祖、世宗之心，調劑寬猛，養忠厚和平之福，任用老成；

translations.literal: Especially may the two empress dowagers and our emperor embody the hearts of the Sacred Ancestor and Shizong, balance severity and lenience, cultivate the blessing of loyal mildness and peace, and employ experienced elders;
translations.idiomatic: Above all, may the two empress dowagers and our emperor embody the hearts of the Kangxi and Yongzheng emperors, balance severity and lenience, cultivate loyal mildness and peace, and employ experienced elders;

sentences.zh: 毋爭外國之所獨爭，為中華留不盡；

translations.literal: do not contend over what foreign states contend over alone, and leave inexhaustible store for China;
translations.idiomatic: do not contest what foreign powers contest among themselves alone, and leave inexhaustible reserves for China;

sentences.zh: 毋創祖宗之所未創，為子孫留有餘。

translations.literal: do not create what ancestors never created, and leave surplus for posterity.
translations.idiomatic: do not innovate what ancestors never innovated, and leave surplus for posterity.

sentences.zh: 罪臣言畢於斯，命畢於斯，謹以大統所繫上聞。

translations.literal: This guilty official's words end here, his life ends here; respectfully reporting what concerns the great succession.
translations.idiomatic: Your guilty servant's words end here, his life ends here; I respectfully report what concerns the great succession.

sentences.zh: 」吏部奏諸朝，詔憫其忠，予優恤。

translations.literal: " The Ministry of Personnel reported to the entire court; an edict pitied his loyalty and granted favorable condolence.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Personnel reported to the whole court; an edict pitied his loyalty and granted favorable condolence.

sentences.zh: 下群臣議，遂定以繼德宗之統為穆宗之子，無異論。

translations.literal: The matter was sent down for discussion among ministers; it was then settled that inheriting Dezong's succession as son of Muzong should stand, without dissent.
translations.idiomatic: The matter was referred to the ministers for discussion; it was then settled that Guangxu should inherit the throne as Tongzhi's son, without dissent.

sentences.zh: 可讀臨歿遺書與其子之桓，謂出薊州一步即非死所。

translations.literal: Kedu in a dying letter to his son Zhihuan said that one step beyond Jizhou would not be the place to die.
translations.idiomatic: In a dying letter to his son Zhihuan, Kedu said that one step beyond Jizhou would not be the place to die.

sentences.zh: 之桓遂成其遺志，葬薊州。

translations.literal: Zhihuan thus fulfilled his last wish and buried him at Jizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zhihuan fulfilled his father's last wish and buried him at Jizhou.

sentences.zh: 都人即所居城南舊宅祠祀之。

translations.literal: The capital's people established a shrine at his old residence south of the city.
translations.idiomatic: The people of the capital established a shrine at his old residence south of the city.

sentences.zh: 有潘敦儼者，字清畏，籍江寧，總督鐸子。

translations.literal: There was Pan Dunyi, courtesy name Qingwei, registered in Jiangning, son of Governor-General Duo.
translations.idiomatic: There was Pan Dunyi, styled Qingwei, registered in Jiangning, son of Governor-General Duo.

sentences.zh: 以任子官工部郎中，遷御史。

translations.literal: By yinzi privilege he served as director in the Ministry of Works, then became censor.
translations.idiomatic: Through yinzi privilege he served as director in the Ministry of Works, then became a censor.

sentences.zh: 默念穆宗嗣統未有定議，孝哲毅皇后又仰藥殉，遂疏請表揚穆後潛德，更諡號，並解醇親王奕枻職任，詔嚴斥奪職。

translations.literal: Brooding that Muzong's succession had no fixed conclusion and that Empress Xiaozheyi had swallowed poison in martyrdom, he memorialized to commend the late empress's hidden virtue, revise her posthumous title, and dismiss Prince Chun Yixin from office; an edict sternly rebuked him and removed him from office.
translations.idiomatic: Brooding that Tongzhi's succession remained unsettled and that Empress Xiaozheyi had taken poison in martyrdom, he memorialized to commend the late empress's hidden virtue, revise her posthumous title, and dismiss Prince Chun Yixin from office; an edict sternly rebuked him and stripped him of his post.

sentences.zh: 歸隱於酒，閱二十餘年，卒。

translations.literal: He retired to seclusion in wine; after more than twenty years he died.
translations.idiomatic: He retired into wine-soaked seclusion; after more than twenty years he died.

sentences.zh: 朱一新，字蓉生，浙江義烏人。

translations.literal: Zhu Yixin, courtesy name Rongsheng, was a native of Yiwu in Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Yixin, styled Rongsheng, came from Yiwu in Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 鄉舉對策語觸時忌，主司李文田特拔之。

translations.literal: In the provincial examination his policy essay touched contemporary taboos, but chief examiner Li Wentian specially advanced him.
translations.idiomatic: In the provincial examination his policy essay touched contemporary taboos, but chief examiner Li Wentian specially advanced him.

sentences.zh: 入貲為內閣中書。

translations.literal: He purchased office as a secretary in the Grand Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: He purchased office as a secretary in the Grand Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 光緒二年，成進士，選庶吉士，授編修。

translations.literal: In the second year of Guangxu he passed the metropolitan examination, was selected as a Hanlin bachelor, and appointed compiler.
translations.idiomatic: In 1876 he became a jinshi, was selected as a Hanlin bachelor, and appointed compiler.

sentences.zh: 法越事起，數上書主戰，又嘗畫海防策，語至切要。

translations.literal: When the Franco-Vietnamese affair arose, he repeatedly memorialized urging war; he also once drafted a coastal defense plan, its language most urgent and essential.
translations.idiomatic: When the Franco-Vietnamese conflict broke out, he repeatedly memorialized urging war; he also drafted a coastal defense plan whose language was urgent and to the point.

sentences.zh: 典湖北鄉試，稱得士。

translations.literal: He presided over the Hubei provincial examination and was praised for selecting worthy men.
translations.idiomatic: As chief examiner for Hubei he was praised for selecting worthy candidates.

sentences.zh: 十一年，轉御史，連上封事，言論侃侃，不避貴戚。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he became censor, repeatedly submitting sealed memorials; his discourse was forthright and he did not avoid the powerful.
translations.idiomatic: In 1885 he became a censor and repeatedly submitted sealed memorials; his discourse was forthright and he did not spare the powerful.

sentences.zh: 內侍李蓮英漸著聲勢。

translations.literal: The eunuch Li Lianying gradually gained prominence.
translations.idiomatic: The eunuch Li Lianying gradually grew in influence.

sentences.zh: 逾歲，醇親王奕枻閱海軍，蓮英從，一新憂之。

translations.literal: The next year Prince Chun Yixin inspected the navy and Lianying accompanied him; Yixin was troubled.
translations.idiomatic: The next year Prince Chun Yixin inspected the navy with Lianying in attendance; Yixin was deeply troubled.

sentences.zh: 而適值山東患河，燕、晉、蜀、閩患水，遂以遇災修省為言，略曰：「我朝家法，嚴馭宦寺。

translations.literal: It happened that Shandong suffered from the Yellow River, and Yan, Jin, Shu, and Min suffered from floods; he therefore spoke under the theme of meeting calamity with self-examination, saying in summary: "Our dynasty's house law strictly controls eunuchs."
translations.idiomatic: Just then Shandong suffered from the Yellow River and Yan, Jin, Shu, and Fujian from floods; he therefore spoke under the theme of meeting calamity with self-examination, saying in summary: "Our dynasty's house law strictly controls eunuchs."

sentences.zh: 世祖宮中立鐵牌，更億萬年，昭為法守。

translations.literal: The Shizu emperor set up an iron plaque in the palace, to stand for ten thousand myriad years as a proclaimed law to be kept.
translations.idiomatic: The Shunzhi emperor set up an iron plaque in the palace, to stand for ten thousand generations as a proclaimed law to be kept.

sentences.zh: 聖母垂簾，安得海假採辦出京，立寘重典。

translations.literal: When the sacred mother held the curtain, how could they recklessly borrow procurement to leave the capital—severe punishment was immediately applied.
translations.idiomatic: When the empress dowager held the curtain, how could they recklessly use procurement as a pretext to leave the capital—severe punishment was immediately applied.

sentences.zh: 皇上登極，張得喜等情罪尤重，謫配為奴。

translations.literal: When our emperor ascended the throne, Zhang Dexi and others, whose circumstances and crimes were especially grave, were banished and assigned as slaves.
translations.idiomatic: When our emperor ascended the throne, Zhang Dexi and others, whose crimes were especially grave, were banished and enslaved.

sentences.zh: 是以綱紀肅然，罔敢恣肆。

translations.literal: Thus discipline was stern and none dared act wantonly.
translations.idiomatic: Thus discipline was stern and none dared act wantonly.

sentences.zh: 乃今夏巡閱海軍之役，太監李蓮英隨至天津，道路譁傳，士庶駴愕，意深宮或別有不得已苦衷，匪外廷所能喻。

translations.literal: Yet this summer, in the tour to inspect the navy, the eunuch Li Lianying followed to Tianjin; the roads buzzed with rumor and scholars and commoners were startled, thinking the inner palace might have some other unavoidable bitter reason that the outer court could not comprehend.
translations.idiomatic: Yet this summer, during the naval inspection tour, the eunuch Li Lianying followed to Tianjin; rumor spread along the roads and scholars and commoners were startled, thinking the inner palace might have some unavoidable reason the outer court could not fathom.

sentences.zh: 然宗籓至戚，閱軍大典，而令刑餘之輩《廣則》乎其間，其將何以詰戎兵崇體制？

translations.literal: Yet an imperial prince of closest kin, at the great ceremony of troop inspection, had emasculated attendants mingling among them—how then to interrogate the troops and exalt institutional dignity?
translations.idiomatic: Yet an imperial prince of closest kin, at the great ceremony of troop inspection, had castrated attendants mingling among them—how then to discipline the troops and uphold institutional dignity?

sentences.zh: 況作法於涼，其弊猶貪。

translations.literal: Moreover, if one sets the pattern in leniency, the abuse will still be greed.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, if one sets the pattern in leniency, the abuse will still be greed.

sentences.zh: 唐之監軍，豈其本意，積漸者然也。

translations.literal: Tang's army supervisors were surely not the original intent—it came from gradual accumulation.
translations.idiomatic: Tang's army supervisors were surely not the original intent—it came from gradual accumulation.

sentences.zh: 聖朝法制修明，萬無慮此。

translations.literal: Our sage dynasty's laws and institutions are well ordered; there is no need to worry of this.
translations.idiomatic: Our dynasty's laws and institutions are well ordered; there is no need to worry of this.

sentences.zh: 而涓涓弗塞，流弊難言，杜漸防微，亦宜垂意。

translations.literal: The empress dowager has already returned power; if she still restrains affairs on every matter, how can she face the ancestors above and the world's ministers and people below?
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager has already returned power; if she still restrains affairs on every matter, how can she face the ancestors above and the world's ministers and people below?

sentences.zh: 至李蓮英是何人斯，敢干政事乎？

translations.literal: As for Li Lianying—what sort of person is he to dare meddle in government?
translations.idiomatic: As for Li Lianying—what sort of person is he to dare meddle in government?

sentences.zh: 如果屬實，律以祖宗法制，豈復可容？

translations.literal: If it is true, judged by ancestral law and institutions, how could it still be tolerated?
translations.idiomatic: If it is true, judged by ancestral law and institutions, how could it still be tolerated?

sentences.zh: 唯是朝廷受李鴻章哃喝，不及詳審，而樞臣中或系私黨，甘心左袒，或恐決裂，姑事調停。

translations.literal: Only that the court is hectored by Li Hongzhang and cannot examine in detail; among grand councilors some belong to private factions and willingly lean to one side, or fear rupture and for the moment mediate.
translations.idiomatic: Only that the court is hectored by Li Hongzhang and cannot examine in detail; among grand councilors some belong to private factions and willingly lean to one side, or fear rupture and for the moment mediate.

sentences.zh: 李鴻章事事挾制朝廷，抗違諭旨。

translations.literal: Li Hongzhang on every matter coerces the court and resists imperial edicts.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hongzhang on every matter coerces the court and resists imperial edicts.

sentences.zh: 唯冀皇上赫然震怒，明正其罪，佈告天下，如是而將士有不奮興、賊人有不破滅者，即請斬臣以正妄言之罪。

translations.literal: Only hoping our emperor will suddenly blaze in anger, clearly rectify his crimes, and proclaim to all under Heaven; if after this officers and soldiers do not rouse themselves or enemies are not destroyed, then I beg that this minister be beheaded to rectify the crime of reckless speech.
translations.idiomatic: Only hoping our emperor will suddenly blaze in anger, clearly rectify his crimes, and proclaim to all under Heaven; if after this officers and soldiers do not rouse themselves or enemies are not destroyed, then I beg that I be beheaded to rectify the crime of reckless speech.

sentences.zh: 」疏入，上諭：「軍國要事，仰承懿訓遵行，天下共諒。

translations.literal: " When the memorial entered, the emperor instructed: "Military and state essentials rely on august instruction and are carried out; all under Heaven jointly understand."
translations.idiomatic: When the memorial entered, the emperor instructed: "Military and state essentials rely on august instruction and are carried out; all under Heaven jointly understand."

sentences.zh: 乃安維峻封奏，託諸傳聞，竟有'皇太后遇事牽制'之語，妄言無忌，恐開離間之端。

translations.literal: Yet An Weijun's sealed memorial, resting on rumor, actually had the words 'the empress dowager restrains affairs on every matter'—reckless speech without restraint, fearing it may open a breach of estrangement.
translations.idiomatic: Yet An Weijun's sealed memorial, resting on rumor, actually had the words 'the empress dowager restrains affairs on every matter'—reckless speech without restraint, fearing it may open a breach of estrangement.

sentences.zh: 」命革職發軍台。

translations.literal: " He was ordered stripped of office and sent to the military garrison.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered stripped of office and sent to the military garrison.

sentences.zh: 維峻以言獲罪，直聲震中外，人多榮之。

translations.literal: Weijun was punished for his words; his upright reputation shook China and abroad, and many honored him.
translations.idiomatic: Weijun was punished for his words; his upright reputation shook China and abroad, and many honored him.

sentences.zh: 訪問者萃於門，餞送者塞於道，或贈以言，或資以贐，車馬飲食，眾皆為供應。

translations.literal: Visitors gathered at his gate, farewell senders blocked the road; some gave words, some supplied travel funds; carriage, horses, food, and drink—all were provided by the crowd.
translations.idiomatic: Visitors gathered at his gate, farewell senders blocked the road; some gave words, some supplied travel funds; carriage, horses, food, and drink—all were provided by the crowd.

sentences.zh: 抵戍所，都統以下皆敬以客禮，聘主講掄才書院。

translations.literal: On reaching the garrison post, the military governor and all below treated him with guest ceremony and engaged him as chief lecturer at Luncai Academy.
translations.idiomatic: On reaching the garrison post, the military governor and all below treated him with guest ceremony and engaged him as chief lecturer at Luncai Academy.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，釋還，遂歸里。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year he was released and returned home.
translations.idiomatic: In 1899 he was released and returned home.

sentences.zh: 三十四年，起授內閣侍讀，充京師大學總教習。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fourth year he was recalled, appointed reader in the Grand Secretariat, and made chief instructor of the Capital University.
translations.idiomatic: In 1908 he was recalled, appointed reader in the Grand Secretariat, and made chief instructor of the Capital University.

sentences.zh: 宣統三年，复辭歸。

translations.literal: In the third year of Xuantong he again resigned and returned.
translations.idiomatic: In 1911 he again resigned and returned home.

sentences.zh: 越十有五年，卒。

translations.literal: After more than fifteen years he died.
translations.idiomatic: More than fifteen years later he died.

sentences.zh: 維峻崇樸實，尚​​踐履，不喜為博辨，尤嚴義利之分。

translations.literal: Weijun esteemed plain solidity, valued practical conduct, disliked broad disputation, and was especially strict in the division of righteousness and profit.
translations.idiomatic: Weijun esteemed plain solidity, valued practical conduct, disliked broad disputation, and was especially strict in the division of righteousness and profit.

sentences.zh: 歸後退隱柏崖，杜門著書，隱然以名教綱常為己任。

translations.literal: After returning he retired to seclusion at Baiya, closed his door to write books, and quietly took orthodox teaching and constant norms as his charge.
translations.idiomatic: After returning he retired to seclusion at Baiya, closed his door to write books, and quietly took orthodox teaching and constant norms as his charge.

sentences.zh: 每談及世變，輒憂形於色，卒抑鬱以終。

translations.literal: Whenever he spoke of worldly change, worry showed on his face; he finally ended in depression.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever he spoke of worldly change, worry showed on his face; he finally ended in depression.

sentences.zh: 著有四書講義、詩文集。

translations.literal: He authored Expositions on the Four Books and collected poems and prose.
translations.idiomatic: He authored Expositions on the Four Books and collected poems and prose.

sentences.zh: 文悌，字仲恭，瓜爾佳氏，滿洲正黃旗人。

translations.literal: Wen Ti, courtesy name Zhonggong, of the Guwalgiya clan, was a Bannerman of the Plain Yellow in Manchuria.
translations.idiomatic: Wen Ti, styled Zhonggong, of the Guwalgiya clan, was a Bannerman of the Plain Yellow in Manchuria.

sentences.zh: 以筆帖式歷戶部郎中，出為河南知府，改御史。

translations.literal: From clerk he passed through director in the Ministry of Revenue, went out as prefect of Henan, and was changed to censor.
translations.idiomatic: From clerk he passed through director in the Ministry of Revenue, went out as prefect of Henan, and was changed to censor.

sentences.zh: 光緒二十四年，變法詔下，禮部主事王照應詔上言，尚書許應騤不為代奏。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year of Guangxu, when the reform edict was issued, Wang Zhao of the Ministry of Rites responded to the edict with a memorial; Minister Xu Yingkui did not transmit it.
translations.idiomatic: In 1898, when the reform edict was issued, Wang Zhao of the Ministry of Rites responded to the edict with a memorial; Minister Xu Yingkui did not transmit it.

sentences.zh: 御史宋伯魯、楊深秀聯名劾以守舊迂謬，阻撓新政，諭應騤明白回奏，覆奏稱珍惜名器，物色通才，並辭連工部主事康有為，請罷斥驅逐。

translations.literal: Censors Song Bolu and Yang Shenxiu jointly impeached him for conservatism, pedantry, and obstruction of the new policy; an edict ordered Yingkui to reply clearly; his reply said he cherished titles and offices and sought able men, and also implicated Kang Youwei, principal clerk in the Ministry of Works, requesting dismissal and expulsion.
translations.idiomatic: Censors Song Bolu and Yang Shenxiu jointly impeached him for conservatism, pedantry, and obstruction of the new policy; an edict ordered Yingkui to reply clearly; his reply said he cherished titles and offices and sought able men, and also implicated Kang Youwei, principal clerk in the Ministry of Works, requesting dismissal and expulsion.

sentences.zh: 奏上，以抑格言路，首違詔旨，禮部尚書、侍郎皆革職，賞照四品京堂。

translations.literal: When the memorial went up, for suppressing the path of frank speech and first violating the edict's intent, the minister and vice ministers of Rites were all stripped of office; Ti was rewarded with fourth-rank capital official status like Wang Zhao.
translations.idiomatic: When the memorial went up, for suppressing the path of frank speech and first violating the edict's intent, the minister and vice ministers of Rites were all stripped of office; Ti was rewarded with fourth-rank capital official status like Wang Zhao.

sentences.zh: 文悌以言官為人指使，黨庇報復，紊亂臺諫，遂上疏言：「康有為向不相識，忽踵門求謁，送以所著書籍，閱其著作，以變法為宗。

translations.literal: Wen Ti, as a speaking official directed by others, factionally shielded revenge and disordered the censorate; he therefore memorialized: "Kang Youwei was previously unknown to me; suddenly he followed to my door seeking audience and presented his authored books; reading his writings, he takes reform as his sect."
translations.idiomatic: Wen Ti, as a speaking official directed by others, factionally shielded revenge and disordered the censorate; he therefore memorialized: "Kang Youwei was previously unknown to me; suddenly he followed to my door seeking audience and presented his authored books; reading his writings, he takes reform as his sect."

sentences.zh: 而尤堪駭詫者，託辭孔子改制，謂孔子作春秋西狩獲麟為受命之符，以春秋變週為孔子當一代王者。

translations.literal: What is especially shocking is that he uses Confucius's institutional reform as a pretext, saying Confucius wrote the Spring and Autumn Annals and that the western hunt and capture of the qilin were signs of receiving the mandate, and that changing Zhou through the Spring and Autumn meant Confucius should be king for an age.
translations.idiomatic: What is especially shocking is that he uses Confucius's institutional reform as a pretext, saying Confucius wrote the Spring and Autumn Annals and that the western hunt and capture of the qilin were signs of receiving the mandate, and that changing Zhou through the Spring and Autumn meant Confucius should be king for an age.

sentences.zh: 明似推崇孔子，實則自申其改制之義。

translations.literal: Outwardly it seems to exalt Confucius; in reality it asserts his own meaning of institutional reform.
translations.idiomatic: Outwardly it seems to exalt Confucius; in reality it asserts his own meaning of institutional reform.

sentences.zh: 乃知康有為之學術，正如漢書嚴助所謂以春秋為蘇秦縱橫者耳。

translations.literal: Thus one knows Kang Youwei's learning is just as Yan Zhu in the Han History said—using the Spring and Autumn for Su Qin's horizontal and vertical alliances.
translations.idiomatic: Thus one knows Kang Youwei's learning is just as Yan Zhu in the Han History said—using the Spring and Autumn for Su Qin's horizontal and vertical alliances.

sentences.zh: 及聆其談治術，則專主西學，以師法日本為良策。

translations.literal: When one hears him discuss methods of governance, he exclusively advocates Western learning and taking Japan as model for good policy.
translations.idiomatic: When one hears him discuss methods of governance, he exclusively advocates Western learning and taking Japan as model for good policy.

sentences.zh: 如近來時務、知新等報所論，尊俠力，伸民權，興黨會，改制度，甚則欲去拜跪之禮儀，廢滿、漢之文字，平君臣之尊卑，改男女之外內。

translations.literal: As recent papers such as Current Affairs and Knowledge of the New discuss: honor chivalric force, extend people's rights, establish party associations, change institutions—even wishing to remove bowing and kneeling ritual, abolish Manchu and Han script, level noble and base between ruler and minister, and alter inner and outer between men and women.
translations.idiomatic: As recent papers such as Current Affairs and Knowledge of the New discuss: honor chivalric force, extend people's rights, establish party associations, change institutions—even wishing to remove bowing and kneeling ritual, abolish Manchu and Han script, level noble and base between ruler and minister, and alter inner and outer between men and women.

sentences.zh: 直似只須中國一變而為外洋政教風俗，即可立致富強，而不知其勢小則群起鬥爭，立可召亂；

translations.literal: It seems as if China need only change at once into foreign government, teaching, and custom to become rich and strong immediately, without knowing that on a small scale groups rise to fight and disorder is quickly summoned;
translations.idiomatic: It seems as if China need only change at once into foreign government, teaching, and custom to become rich and strong immediately, without knowing that on a small scale groups rise to fight and disorder is quickly summoned;

sentences.zh: 大則各便私利，賣國何難？

translations.literal: on a large scale each seeks private advantage—how hard is selling the state?
translations.idiomatic: on a large scale each seeks private advantage—how hard is selling the state?

sentences.zh: 曾以此言戒勸康有為，乃不思省改，且更私聚數百人，在輦轂之下，立為保國會，日執途人而號之曰：'中國必亡，必亡！

translations.literal: I once used these words to admonish Kang Youwei, yet he did not reflect and reform; moreover he privately gathered several hundred men under the capital, established a Society to Protect the State, and daily seized passersby crying: 'China must perish, must perish!'
translations.idiomatic: I once used these words to admonish Kang Youwei, yet he did not reflect and reform; moreover he privately gathered several hundred men under the capital, established a Society to Protect the State, and daily seized passersby crying: 'China must perish, must perish!'

sentences.zh: '以致士夫惶駭，庶眾搖惑。

translations.literal: ' causing scholars to panic in fear and the common people to waver in confusion.
translations.idiomatic: Causing scholars to panic in fear and the common people to waver in confusion.

sentences.zh: 設使四民解體，大盜生心，藉此以集聚匪徒，招誘黨羽，因而犯上作亂，未知康有為又何以善其後？

translations.literal: Suppose the four classes dissolve, great bandits take heart, and by this means gather ruffians and recruit party followers, thereby rebelling against superiors and making disorder—who knows how Kang Youwei would then set things right afterward?
translations.idiomatic: Suppose the four classes dissolve, great bandits take heart, and by this means gather ruffians and recruit party followers, thereby rebelling against superiors and making disorder—who knows how Kang Youwei would then set things right afterward?

sentences.zh: 曾令其將忠君愛國合為一事，勿徒欲保中國而置我大清於度外，康有為亦似悔之。

translations.literal: I once ordered him to unite loyalty to the ruler and love of country in one matter, not merely wishing to preserve China while placing our Great Qing outside consideration; Kang Youwei also seemed to repent.
translations.idiomatic: I once ordered him to unite loyalty to the ruler and love of country in one matter, not merely wishing to preserve China while placing our Great Qing outside consideration; Kang Youwei also seemed to repent.

sentences.zh: 又曾手書御史名單一紙，欲臣倡首鼓動眾人伏闕痛哭，力請變法。

translations.literal: He also once handwrote a list of censor names on a sheet, wishing this minister to take the lead in stirring the multitude to prostrate themselves weeping at the palace gate and forcefully request reform.
translations.idiomatic: He also once handwrote a list of censor names on a sheet, wishing me to take the lead in stirring the multitude to prostrate themselves weeping at the palace gate and forcefully request reform.

sentences.zh: 當告以言官結黨為國朝大禁，此事萬不可為。

translations.literal: I should have told him that censors forming factions is a great prohibition of our dynasty; this matter must never be done.
translations.idiomatic: I told him that censors forming factions is a great prohibition of our dynasty; this matter must never be done.

sentences.zh: 以康有為一人在京城任意妄為，遍結言官，把持國事，已足駭人聽聞；

translations.literal: That Kang Youwei alone in the capital acted wantonly at will, broadly linked speaking officials, and controlled state affairs is already enough to startle listeners;
translations.idiomatic: That Kang Youwei alone in the capital acted wantonly at will, broadly linked speaking officials, and controlled state affairs is already enough to startle listeners;

sentences.zh: 而宋伯魯、楊深秀身為臺諫，公然聯名庇黨，誣參朝廷大臣，此風何可長也！

translations.literal: yet Song Bolu and Yang Shenxiu, themselves censorial remonstrators, openly joined names to shield factions and falsely impeach court ministers—how can this wind be allowed to grow!
translations.idiomatic: yet Song Bolu and Yang Shenxiu, themselves censorial remonstrators, openly joined names to shield factions and falsely impeach court ministers—how can this wind be allowed to grow!

sentences.zh: 伏思國家變法，原為整頓國事，非欲敗壞國事。

translations.literal: Reflecting humbly, state reform was originally to put national affairs in order, not to ruin national affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Reflecting humbly, state reform was originally to put national affairs in order, not to ruin national affairs.

sentences.zh: 譬如屋宇年久失修，自應招工依法改造，若任三五喜事之徒曳之傾倒，而曰非此不能從速，恐梁棟毀折，且將傷人。

translations.literal: It is like a house long unrepaired that should naturally hire workers to remodel according to law; if one lets three or five rash enthusiasts drag it to collapse and says nothing else can be quick, I fear beams and pillars will break and people will be harmed.
translations.idiomatic: It is like a house long unrepaired that should naturally hire workers to remodel according to law; if one lets three or five rash enthusiasts drag it to collapse and says nothing else can be quick, I fear beams and pillars will break and people will be harmed.

sentences.zh: 康有為之變法，何以異是？

translations.literal: How does Kang Youwei's reform differ from this?
translations.idiomatic: How does Kang Youwei's reform differ from this?

sentences.zh: 此所以不敢已於言也。

translations.literal: This is why I dare not stop speaking.
translations.idiomatic: This is why I dare not stop speaking.

sentences.zh: 」疏上，斥回原衙門行走。

translations.literal: " When the memorial went up, he was rebuked and sent back to serve in his original office.
translations.idiomatic: When the memorial went up, he was rebuked and sent back to serve in his original office.

sentences.zh: 太后復訓政，賞文悌知府，旋授河南知府。

translations.literal: When the empress dowager resumed regency, Ti was rewarded with prefect status and soon appointed prefect of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: When the empress dowager resumed regency, Ti was rewarded with prefect status and soon appointed prefect of Henan.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，兩宮西狩，文悌迎駕，擢貴西道。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year, when the two palaces went west on campaign, Ti welcomed the imperial procession and was promoted to Guixi Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In 1900, when the court fled west, Ti welcomed the imperial procession and was promoted to Guixi Circuit.

sentences.zh: 乞病歸，卒。

translations.literal: He begged leave on grounds of illness and returned home, then died.
translations.idiomatic: He begged leave on grounds of illness and returned home, then died.

sentences.zh: 江春霖，字杏村，福建莆田人。

translations.literal: Jiang Chunlin, courtesy name Xingcun, was a native of Putian in Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Chunlin, styled Xingcun, came from Putian in Fujian.

sentences.zh: 光緒二十年進士，選庶吉士，授檢討。

translations.literal: A jinshi in the twentieth year of Guangxu, he was selected as Hanlin bachelor and appointed reviser.
translations.idiomatic: A jinshi in 1894, he was selected as Hanlin bachelor and appointed reviser.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，轉御史，首論都御史陸寶忠幹煙禁，不宜為台長，劾親貴及樞臣疆臣，章凡數十上。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year he became censor, first arguing that Censor-in-Chief Lu Baozhong interfered with the opium ban and should not head the censorate; he impeached imperial kin and grand councilors and frontier governors, memorials numbering several tens.
translations.idiomatic: In 1903 he became a censor, first arguing that Censor-in-Chief Lu Baozhong interfered with the opium ban and should not head the censorate; he impeached imperial kin and grand councilors and frontier governors, memorials numbering several tens.

sentences.zh: 德宗季葉，袁世凱出督畿輔，入贊樞廷，權勢傾一時。

translations.literal: In the late reign of Emperor Dezong, Yuan Shikai went out to govern the capital region, entered to assist the Grand Council, and his power and influence dominated the age.
translations.idiomatic: In the late reign of Emperor Guangxu, Yuan Shikai went out to govern the capital region, entered to assist the Grand Council, and his power and influence dominated the age.

sentences.zh: 春霖獨論列十二事，謂：「洪範有言：'臣之有作威作福，其害於爾家，兇於爾國。

translations.literal: Chunlin alone enumerated twelve matters, saying: "The Hong Fan states: 'When ministers bestow blessing and wield power, it harms your house and is baleful to your state.'"
translations.idiomatic: Chunlin alone enumerated twelve matters, saying: "The Hong Fan states: 'When ministers bestow blessing and wield power, it harms your house and is baleful to your state.'"

sentences.zh: '左氏傳云：'受君之祿，是以聚黨，有黨而爭命，罪孰大焉？

translations.literal: ' The Zuo Commentary says: 'Receiving the ruler's salary, one thereby gathers a faction; having a faction and contending for command—what crime is greater?'"
translations.idiomatic: The Zuo Commentary says: 'Receiving the ruler's salary, one thereby gathers a faction; having a faction and contending for command—what crime is greater?'"

sentences.zh: '今世凱所為，其心即使無他，其跡要難共諒。

translations.literal: ' What Shikai does—even if his heart has no other intent—his traces are hard for all to trust together.
translations.idiomatic: What Shikai does—even if his heart has no other intent—his traces are hard for all to trust together.

sentences.zh: 歷考史冊所載權臣，大者貽憂君國，小者禍及身家。

translations.literal: Examining through history the powerful ministers recorded, the great bring worry to ruler and state, the small bring disaster to person and family.
translations.idiomatic: Examining through history the powerful ministers recorded, the great bring worry to ruler and state, the small bring disaster to person and family.

sentences.zh: 窺竊神器之徒，姑置勿論，即功在社稷，如霍光、李德裕、張居正，亦以權寵太盛，傾覆相尋。

translations.literal: Those who coveted the sacred vessel may be set aside for the moment; even those with merit to the altars of soil and grain, such as Huo Guang, Li Deyu, and Zhang Juzheng, also because favor and power grew too great, met overturn in succession.
translations.idiomatic: Those who coveted the throne may be set aside for the moment; even those with merit to the state, such as Huo Guang, Li Deyu, and Zhang Juzheng, also because favor and power grew too great, met overturn in succession.

sentences.zh: 今不獨為國家計，宜加裁抑，即欲使世凱子孫長守富貴，亦不可無善處之法。

translations.literal: Now, not only for the state's sake should restraint be added; even if one wishes Shikai's descendants long to keep wealth and honor, there must still be a good method of handling matters.
translations.idiomatic: Now, not only for the state's sake should restraint be added; even if one wishes Shikai's descendants long to keep wealth and honor, there must still be a good method of handling matters.

sentences.zh: 」嗣是糾彈世凱及慶親王奕劻父子，連上八疏，皆不報，然朝貴頗嚴憚之。

translations.literal: " After this he impeached Shikai and Prince Qing Yikuang father and son, submitting eight memorials in succession, all unanswered, yet court nobles greatly feared him.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter he impeached Yuan Shikai and Prince Qing Yikuang and his son, submitting eight memorials in succession, all unanswered, yet the court nobles greatly feared him.

sentences.zh: 宣統改元，醇親王載灃既攝政，其弟載洵、載濤分長軍諮、海軍，頗用事。

translations.literal: At the change of reign title to Xuantong, Prince Chun Zaifeng having become regent, his brothers Zaixun and Zaitao respectively headed the Army Advisory Council and Navy and wielded considerable power.
translations.idiomatic: When Xuantong began, Prince Chun Zaifeng became regent; his brothers Zaixun and Zaitao headed the Army Advisory Council and Navy respectively and wielded considerable power.

sentences.zh: 春霖謂：「古者鄭寵共叔，失教旋譏，漢驕厲王，不容終病，載在史冊，為萬世戒。

translations.literal: Chunlin said: "In antiquity Duke Zhu of Zheng favored his younger brother—lost instruction and soon met ridicule; Han's arrogant King Li could not end in peace—recorded in historical annals as warnings for ten thousand generations."
translations.idiomatic: Chunlin said: "In antiquity Duke Zhu of Zheng favored his younger brother—lost instruction and soon met ridicule; Han's arrogant King Li could not end in peace—recorded in the annals as warnings for ten thousand generations."

sentences.zh: 二王性成英敏，休戚相關，料不至蹈覆轍，而慎終於始，要宜杜漸防微。

translations.literal: The two princes are by nature intelligent and keen, joy and sorrow linked; presumably they will not tread the old track, yet being careful at the end begins at the start—one must check the gradual and guard the slight.
translations.idiomatic: The two princes are intelligent and keen by nature, their fortunes linked; they presumably will not repeat past errors, yet caution at the finish begins at the start—one must check the gradual and guard the slight.

sentences.zh: 」又謂：「景皇帝以神器付之皇上，衝齡踐阼，軍國重事，監國攝政王主之。

translations.literal: " He also said: "Emperor Xian entrusted the sacred vessel to our emperor; the young sovereign ascended the throne; military and state weighty matters are presided over by the regent."
translations.idiomatic: He also said: "Emperor Xian entrusted the throne to our emperor; the young sovereign ascended the throne; military and state weighty matters are presided over by the regent."

sentences.zh: 治同其樂，亂同其憂，國之不保，家於何寄？

translations.literal: In order they share joy, in disorder they share worry—if the state is not preserved, upon what does the family rely?
translations.idiomatic: In peace they share joy, in turmoil they share worry—if the state is not preserved, upon what can the family rely?

translations.literal: " At the essay's end he again said: "The regency has not reached a year and public talk boils to this extreme."
translations.idiomatic: At the essay's end he again said: "The regency has not reached a year and public talk has boiled to this extreme."

sentences.zh: 臣不禁為祖宗三百年國祚效賈生痛哭流涕長太息矣！

translations.literal: This minister cannot but for the three hundred years of national fortune of the ancestors offer Jia Yi's sobbing, weeping, and long sighs!
translations.idiomatic: Your servant cannot but for the three hundred years of national fortune of the ancestors offer Jia Yi's sobbing, weeping, and long sighs!

sentences.zh: 」明年，又劾江西巡撫馮汝騤謾欺狀，效宋臣包拯七上彈章，末復言：「是非不明，請將前後章奏明詔宣示，敕部平議。

translations.literal: " The next year he again impeached Jiangxi Governor Feng Ruqi for deceit, imitating Song minister Bao Zheng's sevenfold impeachment memorials; at the end he again said: "Right and wrong are unclear—please issue a clear edict proclaiming the former and latter memorials and order the ministry to adjudicate fairly."
translations.idiomatic: The next year he again impeached Jiangxi Governor Feng Ruqi for deceit, imitating Song minister Bao Zheng's sevenfold impeachment memorials; at the end he again said: "Right and wrong are unclear—please issue a clear edict proclaiming the former and latter memorials and order the ministry to adjudicate fairly."

sentences.zh: 」語至戇直，被訶責。

translations.literal: " His words were excessively blunt; he was rebuked.
translations.idiomatic: His words were judged excessively blunt; he was rebuked.

sentences.zh: 复劾奕劻老奸竊位，多引匪人；

translations.literal: He again impeached Yikuang as an old crafty man usurping position, introducing many wicked men;
translations.idiomatic: He again impeached Yikuang as an old crafty man usurping position and introducing many wicked men;

sentences.zh: 非特簡忠良，不足以贊大猷、挽危局。

translations.literal: only by selecting the loyal and good can great plans be assisted and the perilous situation reversed.
translations.idiomatic: only by selecting loyal and worthy men can great plans be assisted and the perilous situation reversed.

sentences.zh: 詞連尚書徐世昌，侍郎楊士琦、沈雲沛，總督陳夔龍、張人駿，巡撫寶棻、恩壽等十數人。

translations.literal: His words implicated Ministers Xu Shichang, Vice Ministers Yang Shiqi and Shen Yunpei, Governors Chen Kuilong and Zhang Renjun, Governors Bao Fen and En Shou, and more than ten others.
translations.idiomatic: His memorial implicated Minister Xu Shichang, Vice Ministers Yang Shiqi and Shen Yunpei, Governors Chen Kuilong and Zhang Renjun, Governors Bao Fen and En Shou, and more than ten others.

sentences.zh: 朝旨再責之，令回原衙門行走。

translations.literal: Court orders again rebuked him and ordered him back to serve in his original office.
translations.idiomatic: The court again rebuked him and ordered him back to serve in his original office.

sentences.zh: 春霖遂稱疾歸。

translations.literal: Chunlin then claimed illness and returned home.
translations.idiomatic: Chunlin then claimed illness and returned home.

sentences.zh: 越八年，卒。

translations.literal: After eight years he died.
translations.idiomatic: Eight years later he died.

sentences.zh: 論曰：有清列帝，家法最嚴，迨至季世，創制垂簾，於是閹寺漸肆，而親貴權要亦聲勢日著，雖有直言敢諫之士，無補危亡，亦盡其心焉而已。

translations.literal: The commentator says: The successive emperors of Qing had the strictest house law; reaching the late age, the institution of curtain governance was created, and thus eunuchs gradually acted boldly while imperial kin and powerful men also daily grew in prestige; though there were frank and remonstrating scholars, they could not remedy peril and extinction—they merely exhausted their hearts.
translations.idiomatic: The commentator says: Qing's successive emperors observed the strictest house law; by the dynasty's end, curtain governance had been instituted, eunuchs grew bold, and imperial kin and powerful men daily gained prestige; though frank remonstrators appeared, they could not stave off ruin—they merely exhausted their hearts.

sentences.zh: 可讀屍諫，幸鑑孤忠。

translations.literal: Kedu died in corpse remonstrance—may his lonely loyalty be regarded.
translations.idiomatic: Kedu remonstrated with his life—may his solitary loyalty be heeded.

sentences.zh: 一新、仁守、維峻先後直言，皆以語侵太后獲罪。

translations.literal: Yixin, Renshou, and Weijun in succession spoke frankly, all punished for words offending the empress dowager.
translations.idiomatic: Yixin, Renshou, and Weijun spoke frankly in turn, all punished for words that offended the empress dowager.

sentences.zh: 文悌言攻結黨，實啟黨爭，而春霖連劾權貴，言尤痛切，當國者終於不悟。

translations.literal: Wen Ti spoke attacking faction but actually opened factional struggle; Chunlin repeatedly impeached the powerful, his words especially cutting—those in power finally did not awaken.
translations.idiomatic: Wen Ti attacked factionalism in words but in fact opened factional struggle; Chunlin repeatedly impeached the powerful in especially cutting language—those in power never awakened.

sentences.zh: 又有太監寇連才，上書泣諫，請太后歸政，廢頤和園，且言：「不為祖宗天下計，獨不自為計？

translations.literal: There was also the eunuch Kou Liancai, who memorialized weeping in remonstrance, requesting the empress dowager return power and abolish the Summer Palace, and saying: "If not for ancestors and empire, will you not even plan for yourself?"
translations.idiomatic: There was also the eunuch Kou Liancai, who memorialized weeping in remonstrance, asking the empress dowager to return power and abolish the Summer Palace, saying: "If you will not plan for the ancestors and the empire, will you not even plan for yourself?"

sentences.zh: 」終以違制被刑以死。

translations.literal: " He was finally executed to death for violating regulations.
translations.idiomatic: He was finally executed for violating regulations.

sentences.zh: 建言又何得以閹官少之？

translations.literal: How can remonstrance be slighted because the remonstrator was a castrated official?
translations.idiomatic: How can good counsel be slighted because the counselor was a eunuch?

sentences.zh: 類無可歸，故附見於此。

translations.literal: His kind had nowhere to be classified; therefore he is appended here for visibility.
translations.idiomatic: His kind had no proper category; therefore he is recorded here by way of appendix.
